summary: Granite Point Mortgage Trust Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that subsidiary GP Commercial JPM LLC amended its Amended and Restated Uncommitted Master Repurchase Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., and the Company amended its related Second Amended and Restated Guarantee Agreement, both dated September 30, 2026. The amendments raise the maximum facility amount to $727.0 million, modify principal payment waterfall mechanics for newly added purchased assets previously financed under Citibank and Morgan Stanley repurchase facilities, and revise the Minimum Interest Expense Coverage Ratio covenant. This is an ordinary financing arrangement, not a special situation.
